name: Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme
benefit:
> **Handholding Support:**

- Comprehensive support including advisory services, training, technical assistance, and supervision.
- Credit linkage through bank loans with collateral-free provisions.
- Full interest subvention and bank guarantee support.
- Provision of catalytic capital grant and venture funding.

> **Support to Implementing Departments:**

- Funding for development of common infra
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be an individual, group, organization, entrepreneur, or innovator. - The applicant should have high potential for wealth and employment generation. - The applicant should be selected as a “Progress Partner” by the Apex Body. - The applicant should be engaged in livelihood, business, startup, or development activities.
